entry.title: TapeDelay 2.0.1
entry.summary: Tape delay with flutter, tone shaping and stereo width. Port of the Schwung module **TapeDelay** by charlesvestal to the MPC/Force plugin host, compiled unchanged from `charlesvestal/schwung-space-delay` at `87e0cbf65cdb` (`MIT`), linked with the mpc-vst-plugins VST2 wrapper and this repository's Schwung adapter `adapters/schwungfx/`. Gen1 build: armv7, glibc ≤ 2.29. ## Sources - module: https://github.com/charlesvestal/schwung-space-delay/tree/87e0cbf65cdb79933718e662552864d15080c714 - wrapper
